title: Highest closing price
statementMd:
What is the highest closing price ever recorded across all tickers? Show symbol, date and price.

Expected columns: `symbol`, `trade_date`, `close`.

Tables: `tickers`, `prices`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Order by close desc and take one.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT symbol, trade_date, close FROM prices ORDER BY close DESC LIMIT 1;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.

expected.query: SELECT symbol, trade_date, close FROM prices ORDER BY close DESC LIMIT 1;
